Achebe joins the meeting, behind him a rather wood furniture filled office with mementos and items that represent his time in the armed forces and as a member of Counsel (think of congress). [b]"Greetings all,"[/b] He says, arranging his papers that he prepared for this. They range from news reports of death tolls to satellite images of Sal compounds, and Achebe takes time to study them once more while waiting for confirmation that all invited are in.

[quote=pantagruel;58838043][i][b]"Very well.[/b]" Chul bowed his head a second time, lifting the green-stared headdress off his bushy head as a sign of respect towards the Sealiph. "[b]The Pantagrueli realm has set its gaze on the utter 'annihilation' of the pagan abomination, yet we lack the strength nor support to enforce such fate in our own borders. I request Irocco pledge full allegiance to Pantagruel's cause in this matter, vice versa for the Sealiphate and her wishes.[/b]"[/i][/quote]
[i]Irman the Stern at this comment ceased his being stationary and made his way over to Sealiph Ibrahim, in a hushed tone he spoke to his Sealiph "Amir Al-Mu'mineen, is it wise to pledge to the cause of another?" Irman had tried to whisper but his naturally loud voice had betrayed him. Ibrahim retorted to his subordinate "I am the custodian of the most Holy Mosque, I will not be ruled by fear when an Islamic brother requires our assistance with Pagans, the infidel of the highest sort." He turned to Chul. "The Iron Sealiphate pledges itself in this righteous cause, as long as I live I swear to abide by my word."[/i]

[i][u][b]The Reintegration of West Burki Island and Northern Integration[/b][/u]

Ten years into independence, West Burki Island has formally been reabsorbed into Indonocaismnic by a democratic and peaceful process. The referendum saw 89% of the island's population cast their votes in favor of reunification. Only 11% opposed it. The agreement to proclaim West Burki Island as the 11th Federal State has been received both locally and at the national level in Indonocaismnic sovereignty. With 90,000 citizens integration, it further increases the diversity of the country. The nations encourage a growth economy along with social empowerment on the island. It brings back territorial claims in the northern seas. This adds to greater economic opportunities through access to key maritime routes and natural resources producing economic aid in the island. Northern Expansions. Historical and cultural ties have been the driving force behind the Northern Expansion initiative, targeting areas inhabited by people who share Indigenous culture, values, and beliefs. The majority population of 3.5 million voted to become part of Indonocaismnic, in the country's unification. The area has both human and non-human Indonocaismnic citizens, promoting equality. Expansion is strong on the federation's values of integration and tolerance of cultural diversity. With new expansion offers access to new resources and enhances trade possibilities. Aside from federal rule to integrate additional states, additional representation within the Federal Assembly. Transition by the government for the new integrated territories with an emphasis on developing infrastructure, public services, and political representation. Ongoing commitment to multicultural policies to ensure continued unity of the expanding federation. And priority in economic development within the new territories' natural and human resources to benefit the larger federation.
[/i]
